Subject: Implementation sizing check-in / model selection for Clearpath Analytics

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short list of information we need to lock down before the technical kickoff so our implementation and CS teams can size the environment and propose a canary plan. Attached: clearpath_requirements_v1.pdf and a quick token estimate workbook.

Quick asks (can you confirm in reply):
- Monthly active requests (MAUs) vs monthly API calls: are you expecting ~2M API calls/month or should we plan for higher?
- Typical prompt size (median and 90th percentile) and typical generated token length for the two main flows: Q&A / assistant and batch summarization.
- Peak concurrency and expected burst factor (you mentioned a 5x burst during weekly syncs — is that accurate?).
- Any mandatory context retention for reruns/search (do you need full conversation history in each call or prefix caching is acceptable)?
- Compliance/GDPR flags we should know about beyond SOC2 (you noted a special EU data residency requirement for analytics exports).

Our initial thinking for model selection (subject to your numbers):
- Live conversational agent: redwood-2-large (or redwood-2-medium for cost-sensitive flows)
- Semantic search/embeddings: redwood-embedding-v1 (dense vector store)
- Summarization/batch jobs: redwood-1-compact with quantized instance for lower cost

Suggested pilot sizing: 2-GPU dedicated pool for canary (mixed workload routing) with autoscale to 4 GPUs during peak; KV/prefix caching enabled to reduce token cost on repeated queries. We can produce more specific latency and cost projections once you confirm the token mix.

Propose a 45-minute kickoff Wed Apr 7 to lock model choices and run through infra constraints. If that works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearpath.ai>

Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation sizing check-in / model selection for Clearpath Analytics

Jordan —

Thanks for this and for capturing the asks. Short answers inline below plus a couple of clarifications. See attached app flow diagram.

- Monthly API calls: planning for ~2.2M calls/month to the backend APIs (mix of interactive sessions ~70% and scheduled batch jobs ~30%).
- Prompt sizes (median / 90th): assistant prompts: 220 / 480 tokens; assistant responses: 430 / 900 tokens. Batch summarization: average prompt ~1,200 tokens with generated summary ~300 tokens.
- Peak concurrency: base concurrency ~80 connections; peak during nightly batch windows and weekly syncs we see spikes that can be ~4.5x baseline.
- Context retention: we prefer prefix caching for active sessions; for audit exports we store session artifacts for 30 days.
- Compliance: SOC2 is primary; for EU customers we need data residency for exports (we can surface the exports from EU only).

We also have a small latency SLA for user-facing flows: median response under 900ms total wall-time for prompt+generation. That’s a hard line for our product.

Happy to join Apr 7, 10am PT for kickoff.

—Sam
Samantha Lee
Product Lead, ML Platform
Clearpath Analytics
samantha@clearpath.ai

Attachment: clearpath_app_flow.png

Sam —

Great, thanks for the numbers — that clarifies a lot. I ran the prompt/response profile through a quick sizing model and here's a pragmatic plan for the April pilot and initial production sizing: attached proposed_sizing_v1.pdf. Highlights: 

Pilot (6 week canary)
- Models: redwood-2-large for interactive agent flows (better latency and coherence on multi-turn); redwood-embedding-v1 for semantic search; redwood-1-compact for scheduled summarization jobs.
- Serving: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs in a dedicated pool with workload-aware routing (interactive on low-latency nodes, batch on quantized nodes).
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for 60% of interactive tokens (based on repeating queries in your 70/30 mix) — we estimate this reduces token generation by ~28% on the interactive side.
- Expected latency (median): ~600–850ms for typical assistant prompts given your token mix; 95th percentile may exceed the SLA during peak without autoscale.
- Cost: rough hosted estimate for pilot: $22k–$30k/month depending on actual burst frequency. Detailed line-items in attached.

Prod sizing (post-canary) — conservative baseline
- Dedicated pool: 6 GPUs with autoscale to 12 GPUs for sustained peak periods (5x baseline headroom)
- Throughput: supports ~2–2.5M calls/month with median latency in target range assuming caching effectiveness and model pinning.

Open items for kickoff:
- Confirm whether EU export residency requires a separate inference pool (we can route exports through EU-only nodes).
- Acceptable cost envelope for production (we can trade model size vs. latency and batching aggressiveness).
- Which flows are high-priority for the canary (interactive assistant + search recommended).

If everyone is aligned I’ll: (1) create a canary rollout plan with technical checkpoints, (2) propose a monitoring dashboard template (latency/cost per route), and (3) schedule an infra sizing sync between your infra lead and our infra team.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed_sizing_v1.pdf
